profile.address: Via Leini angolo Via Reisera, Cebrosa-Settimo Torinese, Turin, Italy
profile.reading: This is Noovle DC Cebrosa, listed in industry directories under the short code Cebrosa DC1, suggesting it may be the first of potentially multiple planned buildings at this site, at Via Leini at the corner of Via Reisera in the Cebrosa area of Settimo Torinese, northeast of Turin, Italy, distinct from the separate Noovle DC Rivoli site west of the city. Directory listings describe it as a fully operational hyperscale data center that opened in 2023, with Noovle marketing materials describing a target power usage effectiveness below 1.3 alongside general sustainability claims tied to ISO and Uptime Institute aligned standards, language that reads as company marketing rather than an independently verified certification specific to this building. Neither Noovle nor the directories checked this session disclose specific power capacity in megawatts or technical floor area for this facility, an honest gap this registry records rather than estimates. As with the neighboring Noovle DC Rivoli and Noovle DC Moncalieri sites, this facility is part of Noovle S.p.A.s wider network of data centers supporting Google Clouds Turin region, which opened in March 2023 as Googles second cloud region in Italy, with Noovle, TIMs cloud subsidiary, providing the underlying data center capacity across multiple buildings scattered around the Turin metropolitan area rather than a single consolidated campus. Settimo Torinese lies northeast of central Turin along the Po river and has historically hosted industrial and logistics activity, and its selection alongside Rivoli and Moncalieri for separate Noovle buildings suggests a deliberate strategy of spreading Google Cloud region capacity across several distinct sites around the metropolitan area rather than concentrating it in a single large campus, likely for resilience and land availability reasons, though Noovle has not published an explicit rationale for this multi site pattern in sources checked this session.
